video_title: How Gregg Popovich Finessed the NBA to Send Steve Novak from the Spurs to Knicks

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' need for a shooter and Steve Novak's availability
quotes.excerpt: It's only a couple shooters out there, just specialists in what they do.
quotes.quote: The thought was we needed is we needed shooting. And it's only a couple shooters out there, just specialists in what they do. And if you get a chance to get one of them, then now you know what type of team you're starting to build. And I think Mike Woodson also understood that. In order for this to work, we need to have this. And he was available and the conversation came to me on hey, we got something that we might we never thought we had a chance to get him. And it was him. At that point it's like, what the fuck are we talking about? Bring him on. We need this. I know what I need for this team. We need this.

quotes.speaker: Steve Novak
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Novak's journey before the Knicks, including being cut and almost going to China
quotes.excerpt: I had been cut by the Dallas Mavericks, the year before, I took a month off, not because I wanted to.
quotes.quote: No. I was so you got to remember it was the lockout. And I almost went I almost took a deal in China. Cuz I had been cut by the Dallas Mavericks, the year before, I took a month off, not because I wanted to, because I was trying to find a team and couldn't. Had re-signed at the end of the year before the lockout with the San Antonio Spurs. The lockout happens. I go back to San Antonio for camp when the lockout ends, just decided not to go back to China. I was almost there.

quotes.speaker: Steve Novak
quotes.summary_phrase: Popovich's initial conversation about Steve Novak's release to the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: Coach Pop is going to call you in the office. He's going to talk to you. I want you to be respectful.
quotes.quote: While I'm in camp with the San Antonio Spurs on a non-guaranteed camp contract, my agent calls me and says for a couple of a day or two and you know, everything's happening fast, only two preseason games before the 66 game season starts. Mark Bartelstein calls me says, when you get to practice today, Coach Pop is going to call you in the office. He's going to talk to you. I want you to be respectful. It's going to be good what's going to happen, but go in there and make sure you're grateful. You say thank you. I said Mark, like what in the what kind of weird message is this? So I go into I go into practice, Coach Pop says, come on, talk to you real quick. I go in, he says, we're going to release you. I said, oh, that's not good. He said, but no, hear me out. You are released, you are going to go get on a plane today and you're going to fly to New York. Coach D'Antoni had called and he said, look, we want Steve. Coach Pop, he said, we don't want to give you up. We want to keep you. So I talked to Coach Pop to Coach D'Antoni. I told him if you guarantee him a one-year deal since he's on a non-guaranteed contract here. And if you guarantee he's going to be a big part of what you're doing, I'll release him.

quotes.speaker: Steve Novak
quotes.summary_phrase: The full revelation of Popovich's plan for Steve Novak's move to the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: Coach Pop released you because he made Coach D'Antoni agree if he took you he was going to be a one year deal.
quotes.quote: And then had to go through waivers. Mark Bartelstein had to call the teams say leave him, leave him, leave him, leave him, leave him. Get to the New York Knicks. And I find all this out while I'm living in Milwaukee, Coach Bud, Coach Budenholzer is the assistant for the Spurs at that time. He was the Bucks coach when I had dinner with him like five years ago. He saying, do you know how this all really happened? I said no. He said Coach Pop released you because he made Coach D'Antoni agree if he took you he was going to be a one year deal. He was going to make it be a big part of the team. And the rest was history, but I think back to Coach Pop and the legend that he is and if it wasn't for him saying, and he said this when he pulled me in the office. This is going to be this is going to be better for you and it's going to be better for your family. He said, trust me, we want you. We pulled you out of the G-League for a reason. We have you back in camp for a reason. We got Matt Bonner here. We got Tim Duncan, we got Manu, we got Tony Parker. We got a squad. We believe in you. This is better for you. And I went at that time I didn't realize all that.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks' strategic need for a shooter under Mike D'Antoni
quotes.excerpt: He wanted more threes. He wanted to play faster. He wanted somebody that's when I'm double team to get like he he wanted that.
quotes.quote: Mike D'Antoni, because of the style of play we wanted to we was trying. Well his style of play was seven seconds or less. So we knew we needed to shoot the ball more. He wanted more threes. He wanted to play faster. He wanted somebody that's when I'm double team to get like he he wanted that and we knew we we needed a real shooter at this point in time. So when the deal happened, that ain't when the conversation started. So it was already as players, it was already like rumblings of like who would be available around the elite. And his name was one of the names that we kept coming up. Man, Steve might be available, Steve might be available. I'm like, yo, now you put the watch on. Listen, if Steve becomes available, you go grab that motherfucker.

quotes.speaker: Steve Novak
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Novak's high assist rate playing with Carmelo Anthony
quotes.excerpt: I said, I want someone else to have the ball. I need a superstar that someone who has the gravity.
quotes.quote: And it's one thing for me too. Like I looked back, I've looked at some of my my career statistics. And like playing for me, playing with a guy like Melo was so important because my first year with the Knicks, this is a real stat. 93% of my made field goal attempts were assisted. My second year with the next, 95% of my made field goals were assisted. And so people would say to me sometimes like, what is it like playing with Melo? Like, oh, he likes to keep the ball in his hands and he likes to shoot and he likes to post, he likes to mid-range, he likes to shoot the. I said, that's exactly what's a dream come true for me. I had a year with Oklahoma City Thunder where I had 100% of my made field goals were assisted. I said, I want someone else to have the ball. I need a superstar that someone who has the gravity to it's the best shot on that possession if Melo has it in the post and it's the best shot if he has in mid-range and the best shot from three, but when the defense says we're going to put two guys, our best two defenders at double team on Melo, I was in the corner and I was ready. And I just love the fact that Melo was like and I see you. A lot of these possessions are mine and they should be. And I was just thrilled to be in the corner spacing and moving how I had to and he was a guy who always was a willing passer and always found me.
